name: Silverleaf Brooch
entries: This delicate brooch is crafted from a real leaf dipped in enchanted silver, preserving its veins and texture in perfect detail.

It serves as a diplomatic passport to the Silverleaf Lands. When worn visibly, the brooch allows the wearer and their traveling companions to pass through the magical wards guarding the elven kingdom.
